pk_model.selection_rationale: Among 240 patients with both models converged, 79 (32.9%) had 2-compartment AICc more than 4 points lower with separable alpha/beta; 161 (67.1%) had no clear two-compartment support. Selected 1-compartment because at least 65% cohort support is required for the more complex structure; 1-compartment remains the default when that threshold is not reached.
